add-red-rectangle-annotation.title: Add Red Rectangle Annotation to PDF Page
add-red-rectangle-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a red rectangle (square) annotation with a 2 mm border, add it to a specific page, and save the modified document.

add-highlight-annotation-to-pdf-page.title: Highlight Specific Text on PDF Page
add-highlight-annotation-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to locate a specific text string on page three of a PDF, retrieve its rectangle, and add a yellow highlight annotation over that range using Aspose.Pdf.

add-sticky-note-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Sticky Note Annotation to First PDF Page
add-sticky-note-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create and place a sticky‑note (text) annotation on the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bookmark-to-pdf-page.title: Add a PDF Bookmark with PdfBookmarkEditor
add-bookmark-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to create a top‑level bookmark named "Project Overview" that navigates to page 5 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor.

create-nested-bookmarks-pdf.title: Create Nested Bookmarks in PDF with PdfBookmarkEditor
create-nested-bookmarks-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a root bookmark and child section bookmarks to an existing PDF using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor class.

add-javascript-click-action-to-pdf-recta.title: Add Rectangle Annotation to PDF (without JavaScript)
add-javascript-click-action-to-pdf-recta.description: Shows how to create a square (rectangle) annotation on a PDF page, set its appearance and tooltip, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf. It also notes the lack of JavaScript action support in older library versions.

add-javascript-calculation-button-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Calculation Button to PDF Form
add-javascript-calculation-button-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a push‑button to a PDF form and attach JavaScript that multiplies the "price" and "quantity" fields to set a "total" field.

extract-first-image-from-pdf-page2-png.title: Extract First Image from PDF Page as PNG
extract-first-image-from-pdf-page2-png.description: Shows how to extract the first image on page 2 of a PDF document and save it as a PNG file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-image-stamp-to-bottom-right-page-3.title: Add Image Stamp to Bottom‑Right of Page 3
add-image-stamp-to-bottom-right-page-3.description: Demonstrates creating an ImageStamp from a PNG file and placing it at the bottom‑right corner of the third page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-confidential-text-stamp.title: Add Confidential Text Stamp with Transparent Background
add-confidential-text-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a red "Confidential" text stamp with a semi‑transparent background, and apply it to every page using Aspose.Pdf.

reposition-stamp-left-margin.title: Reposition Stamp on Page 4 to 10 mm Left Margin
reposition-stamp-left-margin.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, retrieving an existing stamp's geometry, calculating new coordinates to align the stamp 10 mm from the left margin, and updating the stamp position using Aspose.Pdf's PdfStampEditor.

replace-text-in-pdf.title: Replace Text in PDF Using PdfContentEditor
replace-text-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, replace every occurrence of the word "Draft" with "Final", and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

replace-invoicenumber-with-uuid-page-6.title: Replace InvoiceNumber with UUID on PDF Page 6
replace-invoicenumber-with-uuid-page-6.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades to replace a case‑sensitive placeholder text on a specific PDF page with a newly generated UUID and save the result.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-and-default-zo.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences for Continuous Layout and Default Zoom
set-pdf-viewer-preference-and-default-zo.description: Demonstrates how to configure a PDF's viewer preferences to use a single-page continuous layout and a default zoom of 100 % using Aspose.Pdf, with reflection fallback for older library versions.

get-pdf-viewer-preferences-zoom.title: Read PDF Viewer Preferences (Page Layout, Zoom)
get-pdf-viewer-preferences-zoom.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and retrieve its viewer preferences such as page layout, zoom level, zoom mode, and UI visibility settings.

remove-embedded-file-from-pdf.title: Remove Attachment from PDF Document
remove-embedded-file-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate an embedded file by name, delete the attachment, and save the reduced‑size document using Aspose.Pdf.

password-protect-pdf-disable-printing.title: Password Protect PDF and Disable Printing
password-protect-pdf-disable-printing.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption with a user and owner password, and disable all permissions including printing, then save the protected file.

set-pdf-permissions-allow-copy-restrict-.title: Allow Text Copying While Restricting Form Editing in PDF
set-pdf-permissions-allow-copy-restrict-.description: Demonstrates how to apply PDF permissions with Aspose.Pdf so users can extract (copy) text but cannot edit form fields or annotations. The document is encrypted with an owner password and the ExtractContent permission.

add-xmp-metadata-author-title.title: Add XMP Author and Title Metadata to PDF
add-xmp-metadata-author-title.description: Shows how to bind a PDF, add XMP Dublin Core metadata for author and title, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

update-pdf-xmp-metadata-custom-project-s.title: Add Custom XMP Metadata to PDF
update-pdf-xmp-metadata-custom-project-s.description: Shows how to register a custom namespace and embed project identifier and version number as XMP metadata in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

fill-acroform-text-field.title: Fill AcroForm Text Field with Value Using Aspose.Pdf
fill-acroform-text-field.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate the AcroForm text box field "CustomerName", set its value to "Acme Corporation", and save the updated document.

set-checkbox-field-in-pdf-form.title: Set Checkbox Field to Checked in PDF
set-checkbox-field-in-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically locate a checkbox field named "TermsAccepted" in a PDF form and set it to checked using Aspose.Pdf, then save the updated document.

set-radio-button-value-in-pdf-acroform.title: Set Radio Button Value in PDF AcroForm
set-radio-button-value-in-pdf-acroform.description: Demonstrates how to select a specific radio button option (Express) in an AcroForm field of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form.

convert-pdf-page-to-high-res-png.title: Convert PDF Page to High-Resolution PNG
convert-pdf-page-to-high-res-png.description: Shows how to extract a specific page from a PDF and save it as a 300 DPI PNG image using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff-lzw.title: Convert PDF to Multi‑Page TIFF with LZW Compression
convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff-lzw.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's Facade API to convert an entire PDF document into a multi‑page TIFF file while applying LZW compression.

convert-jpeg-to-pdf.title: Convert JPEG Image to PDF
convert-jpeg-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a PDF document, add a page, insert a JPEG image using the default page margins, and save the result as a PDF file.

batch-add-red-rectangle-annotation.title: Batch Add Red Rectangle Annotation to PDFs
batch-add-red-rectangle-annotation.description: Shows how to loop through all PDF files in a folder, add a red rectangle (square) annotation to the first page of each document, and save the annotated PDFs to an output directory using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-replace-confidential-with-public.title: Batch Replace Text in PDFs within a ZIP Archive
batch-replace-confidential-with-public.description: Extracts PDF files from a ZIP archive, uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfContentEditor to replace the phrase "Confidential" with "Public" in each PDF, and repackages the modified files into a new ZIP archive.

batch-set-pdf-viewer-preference-fullscre.title: Batch Set PDF Viewer Preference to Full‑Screen Mode
batch-set-pdf-viewer-preference-fullscre.description: Shows how to iterate over all PDF files in a directory and use Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileMend to enable the ViewerPreferences.FullScreen flag for each document, with reflection handling for version differences.

batch-add-password-protection-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Password Protection to PDFs
batch-add-password-protection-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates iterating over PDF files in a folder and applying identical user and owner passwords using Aspose.Pdf encryption.

convert-pdf-pages-to-transparent-png.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG with Transparent Background at 150 DPI
convert-pdf-pages-to-transparent-png.description: Shows how to batch convert each page of a PDF document to a PNG image with a transparent background and 150 DPI resolution using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-reposition-stamps-top-center.title: Batch Reposition Stamps to Top‑Center of PDF Pages
batch-reposition-stamps-top-center.description: Shows how to process a folder of PDFs, locate stamp annotations on each page, and move each stamp to a top‑center position with a margin before saving the modified files.

add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf-page.title: Add Hyperlink Annotation to PDF Page
add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert a clickable hyperlink annotation on the second page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-javascript-calculate-action-to-pdf-f.title: Add JavaScript to Calculate Total on Quantity Change
add-javascript-calculate-action-to-pdf-f.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor to attach a JavaScript action to a PDF form field so the Total field is automatically computed when the Quantity field value changes.

extract-page5-images-grayscale.title: Extract and Grayscale Images from PDF Page
extract-page5-images-grayscale.description: Shows how to extract all images from a specific PDF page, convert each to grayscale, and save them as JPEG files using Aspose.Pdf.

center-image-stamp-on-page-8.title: Center Image Stamp on Specific PDF Page
center-image-stamp-on-page-8.description: Shows how to add an image stamp that is horizontally and vertically centered on page 8 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-in-pdf-annotations.title: Replace Annotation Text on Selected PDF Pages
replace-text-in-pdf-annotations.description: Loads a PDF, iterates over specified pages, replaces a target string inside each annotation's Contents, and saves the updated document.

hide-toolbar-and-menubar-viewer-preferen.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences to Hide Toolbar and Menu Bar
hide-toolbar-and-menubar-viewer-preferen.description: The example loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, sets the ViewerPreferences to hide the toolbar and menu bar (using dynamic access for compatibility with older library versions), and saves the modified document.

delete-pdf-attachments-matching-old-pdf.title: Remove Attachment Ending with _old.pdf from PDF
delete-pdf-attachments-matching-old-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, searches its embedded files for a name that ends with "_old.pdf", removes the matching attachment, and saves the updated document.

encrypt-pdf-128-aes-restrict-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with 128‑bit AES and Restrict Permissions
encrypt-pdf-128-aes-restrict-permissions.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, apply 128‑bit AES encryption, set all permissions to none, and save the protected document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-custom-xmp-metadata-projectid.title: Add Custom XMP Metadata (ProjectID) to PDF
add-custom-xmp-metadata-projectid.description: Demonstrates how to add or update a custom XMP metadata entry named ProjectID in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and verify that it appears in the document properties.

add-image-stamp-to-page-three-50mm.title: Add Base64 Image Stamp to PDF Page
add-image-stamp-to-page-three-50mm.description: Demonstrates how to decode a Base64‑encoded image, create an ImageStamp, and place it on the third page of a PDF at a 50 mm offset using Aspose.Pdf.

create-multiline-text-stamp.title: Add Multiline Text Stamp with Custom Font and Color
create-multiline-text-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to create a multiline text stamp, set a custom Arial font, size, and blue color, and apply it to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.title: Fill PDF Form Fields from JSON using XFDF
fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.description: Demonstrates how to read a JSON file that maps form field names to values, convert the data to XFDF, and import it into a PDF template using Aspose.Pdf to produce a filled PDF document.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-transparent.title: Convert Selected PDF Pages to PNG with Transparent Background
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-transparent.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, selecting pages 2‑4, and rendering each page to a 200 DPI PNG image with a transparent background using Aspose.Pdf.

silently-print-pdf-to-network-printer.title: Print PDF Silently to a Network Printer
silently-print-pdf-to-network-printer.description: Shows how to send a PDF file to a network printer identified by its IP address using Aspose.Pdf's PdfViewer.PrintDocuments with configured printer and page settings, performing the print job silently.

add-dashed-rectangle-annotation-with-opa.title: Add Dashed Rectangle Annotation with Opacity to PDF Page
add-dashed-rectangle-annotation-with-opa.description: Shows how to place a rectangle (square) annotation with a dashed border and 50% opacity on page 6 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-open-javascript-log-page-number.title: Add JavaScript to Log Page Number on Page Open
add-page-open-javascript-log-page-number.description: Demonstrates how to attach a JavaScript action to each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf so that the current page number is logged to the console when the page is opened.

generate-pdf-catalog-of-extracted-images.title: Create Image Catalog PDF from Source PDF
generate-pdf-catalog-of-extracted-images.description: Extracts every image from an existing PDF and builds a new PDF where each page shows a thumbnail preview of an extracted image.

reposition-stamp-to-baseline-page-5.title: Align Stamp with Text Baseline on Page 5
reposition-stamp-to-baseline-page-5.description: Demonstrates how to extract the baseline coordinates of the first text fragment on a specific PDF page and reposition a text stamp to align with that baseline using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-dates-in-pdf-using-regex.title: Reformat Dates in PDF Using Regex
replace-dates-in-pdf-using-regex.description: Demonstrates how to locate dates in MM/DD/YYYY format within a PDF and replace them with YYYY‑MM‑DD using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragmentAbsorber and regular expressions.

update-pdf-xmp-creator-metadata.title: Update PDF XMP Creator Metadata
update-pdf-xmp-creator-metadata.description: Shows how to load a PDF, modify the XMP "Creator" property using the PdfXmpMetadata facade, and save the updated document.

add-encrypted-attachment-aes256.title: Add Encrypted Attachment to PDF with Custom Description
add-encrypted-attachment-aes256.description: Shows how to encrypt a file using AES‑256, create a FileSpecification with a custom description, and embed the encrypted content into a PDF document.

remove-all-bookmarks-from-pdf.title: Remove All Bookmarks from PDF
remove-all-bookmarks-from-pdf.description: Shows how to delete every bookmark in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor and save the cleaned document.

create-nested-pdf-bookmarks.title: Create Nested PDF Bookmarks with Aspose.Pdf Facade
create-nested-pdf-bookmarks.description: Demonstrates how to generate a simple PDF and add three‑level nested bookmarks (section, subsection, sub‑subsection) using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor API.

add-underlined-text-stamp-to-page-ten.title: Add Underlined Text Stamp with Yellow Background to PDF Page 10
add-underlined-text-stamp-to-page-ten.description: Demonstrates how to add a centered text stamp with underline decoration, a yellow background, and custom styling to page 10 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-pages-to-bmp.title: Convert PDF Pages to 24‑bit BMP Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-bmp.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rendering each page to a 24‑bit BMP file at a specified resolution, and saving the images to a directory.

print-pdf-duplex-collated-copies.title: Print PDF with Duplex and Collated Copies
print-pdf-duplex-collated-copies.description: Shows how to send a PDF to a printer using Aspose.Pdf with duplex (long‑edge) mode enabled and multiple collated copies.

add-rectangle-annotation-light-gray.title: Add Rectangle Annotation with Light Gray Fill
add-rectangle-annotation-light-gray.description: Demonstrates how to add a rectangle (square) annotation to a PDF page, set a light gray interior color, and define a 1 pt solid border using Aspose.Pdf.

add-javascript-validation-button-to-pdf-.title: Add JavaScript Validation to PDF on Open
add-javascript-validation-button-to-pdf-.description: Shows how to embed a JavaScript action in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf that checks required form fields and displays an alert if any are empty when the document is opened.

add-external-url-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add External URL Bookmark to PDF
add-external-url-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a top‑level bookmark in a PDF that opens an external web page when selected, using Aspose.Pdf.

hide-scrollbars-disable-page-transitions.title: Hide UI Elements and Remove Page Transitions from PDF
hide-scrollbars-disable-page-transitions.description: Shows how to hide scrollbars, toolbar, and menubar and disable all page transition effects in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with runtime‑safe handling for different library versions.

extract-viewer-preferences-to-json.title: Extract PDF Viewer Preferences and Save to JSON
extract-viewer-preferences-to-json.description: Shows how to read the page layout and zoom values from a PDF's ViewerPreferences using Aspose.Pdf and write them to a JSON configuration file.

add-attachment-set-modification-date.title: Add Attachment with Audit Date to PDF
add-attachment-set-modification-date.description: Shows how to embed a file into a PDF document and set its modification (audit) date to the current UTC timestamp using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-specific-bookmark-from-pdf.title: Remove Specific Bookmark from PDF
remove-specific-bookmark-from-pdf.description: Shows how to delete a bookmark with a given title from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor.

encrypt-pdf-with-certificate-signature.title: Secure PDF with Certificate Encryption and Signature
encrypt-pdf-with-certificate-signature.description: Demonstrates how to add an invisible PKCS#7 signature field to a PDF, sign it with a certificate, and then encrypt the document with AES‑256 password protection using Aspose.Pdf.

add-text-stamp-with-shadow.title: Add Text Stamp with Shadow to First PDF Page
add-text-stamp-with-shadow.description: Demonstrates creating a text stamp with a shadow effect, size 12, positioned at the top of the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-from-stream.title: Add Image Stamp from Stream to PDF
add-image-stamp-from-stream.description: Demonstrates how to load an image into a memory stream, create an ImageStamp from that stream, and apply the stamp to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf without writing the image to disk.

convert-png-to-multi-page-pdf.title: Convert PNG Images to Multi‑Page PDF
convert-png-to-multi-page-pdf.description: Shows how to read PNG files from a folder, add each image as a separate page, and save the result as a single PDF with default margins.

add-semi-transparent-file-attachment-ann.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Annotation to PDF Page
add-semi-transparent-file-attachment-ann.description: Demonstrates how to add a text annotation with 60% opacity to the third page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-images-from-pdf-rename-by-page-i.title: Extract Images from PDF Pages with Page-Based Naming
extract-images-from-pdf-rename-by-page-i.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save them with filenames that include the page number and image index.

replace-text-preserve-style.title: Replace Text While Preserving Font Style in PDF
replace-text-preserve-style.description: Demonstrates how to locate specific text in a PDF, replace it with new content, and retain the original font, size, and color using Aspose.Pdf.

add-file-attachment-data-relationship.title: Add Data Attachment to PDF
add-file-attachment-data-relationship.description: Shows how to embed a file as a Data attachment in an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-corporate-branding-xmp-metadata.title: Add XMP Branding Metadata to PDF
add-corporate-branding-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to embed custom XMP metadata with a corporate logo URL and brand color into a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multiline-right-aligned-text-stamp-p.title: Add Right-Aligned Multiline Text Stamp to Bottom of Page 4
add-multiline-right-aligned-text-stamp-p.description: Demonstrates how to create a multiline TextStamp, right-align it, and place it at the bottom of the fourth page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-png-thumbnails-300-dpi.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG Thumbnails with 300 DPI and Transparent Background
convert-pdf-to-png-thumbnails-300-dpi.description: Demonstrates how to render each page of a PDF document to a PNG image at 300 DPI with a transparent background, suitable for UI thumbnails.

combine-jpeg-images-to-pdf.title: Combine JPEG Images into a PDF
combine-jpeg-images-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a PDF document and add each JPEG image as a separate page, sizing each page to match the image dimensions.

add-submit-button-confirmation-dialog.title: Add Confirmation Dialog JavaScript to PDF Form
add-submit-button-confirmation-dialog.description: Demonstrates how to embed a JavaScript action that shows a confirmation dialog before submitting a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf.

add-url-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add Help Bookmark with URL to PDF
add-url-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a top‑level bookmark that opens an online documentation URL and add it to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

disable-zoom-controls-in-pdf.title: Disable Zoom Controls and Set Fixed Zoom Level
disable-zoom-controls-in-pdf.description: Shows how to hide PDF viewer toolbar and window UI to remove zoom controls, with a fallback that sets a fixed zoom level using JavaScript when ViewerPreferences are unavailable.

add-file-attachment-with-creation-date.title: Add Attachment with Description and Creation Date to PDF
add-file-attachment-with-creation-date.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF, set its description, and assign the current system time as the creation date using Aspose.Pdf.

add-xmp-department-metadata-to-pdf.title: Add XMP Metadata Field to PDF
add-xmp-department-metadata-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a custom XMP metadata entry (Department = Finance) into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save the document so the property appears in PDF properties.

add-bold-red-centered-text-stamp-page-5.title: Add Centered Red Bold Text Stamp to PDF Page
add-bold-red-centered-text-stamp-page-5.description: Demonstrates how to create a bold red text stamp, center it on the page, and apply it to the fifth page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-scaled-image-stamp-from-memory-strea.title: Add Scaled Image Stamp from Memory Stream to PDF
add-scaled-image-stamp-from-memory-strea.description: Demonstrates loading an image into a MemoryStream, creating an ImageStamp, scaling it to 50% with the Zoom property, and applying it to the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

fill-pdf-acroform-from-xml.title: Fill PDF AcroForm Fields from XML using XPath
fill-pdf-acroform-from-xml.description: Shows how to load an XML file, locate values with XPath, and populate AcroForm fields in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-green-circle-annotation-to-pdf-page.title: Add Green Circle Annotation to PDF Page
add-green-circle-annotation-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to add a circle annotation with a green fill color and a 3 pt border to the second page of an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

embed-memory-stream-as-pdf-attachment.title: Embed In-Memory Attachment into PDF
embed-memory-stream-as-pdf-attachment.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a FileSpecification from a MemoryStream, add it to the document's EmbeddedFiles collection, and save the updated PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-document-attachment-with-description.title: Add Attachment with Descriptive Label to PDF
add-document-attachment-with-description.description: Shows how to embed a file into a PDF and assign a descriptive label using Aspose.Pdf.

add-file-attachment-with-custom-mime.title: Add Custom MIME Type Attachment to PDF
add-file-attachment-with-custom-mime.description: Shows how to embed a file into a PDF document and set a custom MIME type for the attachment using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-all-attachments-from-pdf.title: Remove All Attachments from PDF
remove-all-attachments-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, delete any embedded file attachments, and save the cleaned document.

add-attachment-preserve-existing.title: Add New Attachment to PDF Without Removing Existing Attachments
add-attachment-preserve-existing.description: Shows how to embed an additional file into an existing PDF while keeping any previously embedded files using Aspose.Pdf.

refresh-pdf-attachments.title: Replace PDF Attachments with New Files
refresh-pdf-attachments.description: Demonstrates how to remove all existing embedded file attachments from a PDF and add a fresh set of files as new attachments using Aspose.Pdf.

attach-network-downloaded-file-to-pdf.title: Attach a Downloaded File to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf
attach-network-downloaded-file-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates downloading a file into a byte array, creating a FileSpecification from the data, and embedding it into an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf.

add-large-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Large Attachment to PDF and Monitor Memory Usage
add-large-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates embedding a large (>10 MB) file into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf via a stream to avoid loading the whole attachment into memory, and checks that memory consumption stays within a defined limit.

add-attachment-and-retrieve-name.title: Add Attachment to PDF and Verify File Name
add-attachment-and-retrieve-name.description: Demonstrates embedding a file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, saving the document, and retrieving the embedded file names to confirm the attachment was added.

delete-all-pdf-attachments-verify.title: Delete All Attachments from PDF and Verify Count
delete-all-pdf-attachments-verify.description: Shows how to remove every embedded file from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, save the document, and confirm that the attachment count is zero.

add-attachment-and-list-names.title: Add Attachment to PDF and List Embedded Files
add-attachment-and-list-names.description: Shows how to embed a file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, save the document, and then enumerate the embedded file names to confirm the attachment was added.

add-unicode-attachment-description-to-pd.title: Read Embedded File Descriptions with Unicode from PDF
add-unicode-attachment-description-to-pd.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, access its embedded file attachments, and read their names and Unicode descriptions to verify proper metadata encoding.

add-embedded-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Embedded File Attachment to PDF
add-embedded-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a file as an attachment inside a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf by creating a FileSpecification, setting its properties, and adding it to the document's EmbeddedFiles collection.

add-attachment-and-store-checksum-metada.title: Compute and Store Attachment SHA-256 Checksums in PDF Metadata
add-attachment-and-store-checksum-metada.description: The example loads a PDF, iterates over its embedded file attachments, calculates a SHA‑256 checksum for each attachment, and stores the checksum as custom document metadata for later integrity verification.

encrypt-pdf-attachment-and-add-to-pdf.title: Encrypt and Attach PDF to Another PDF
encrypt-pdf-attachment-and-add-to-pdf.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF attachment with a password using AES‑256 and embed the encrypted file into a main PDF document.

add-attachment-verify-extraction.title: Add and Verify Embedded File Attachment in PDF
add-attachment-verify-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF, extract it back, and verify that the extracted content matches the original file using Aspose.Pdf.

enable-centerwindow-viewer-preference.title: Set PDF CenterWindow Viewer Preference
enable-centerwindow-viewer-preference.description: Shows how to enable the CenterWindow viewer preference so a PDF opens centered, using dynamic to handle library versions that may lack the ViewerPreferences property.

hide-menubar-viewer-preference.title: Hide Menubar Viewer Preference in PDF
hide-menubar-viewer-preference.description: Demonstrates how to enable the HideMenubar viewer preference on a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with a dynamic fallback for older library versions.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-fullscreen.title: Set PDF to Open in FullScreen Mode
set-pdf-viewer-preference-fullscreen.description: Shows how to enable the FullScreen viewer preference so a PDF automatically opens in full‑screen mode, with fallback handling for older Aspose.Pdf versions.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-show-outline.title: Set PDF Viewer Preference to Show Outline Panel
set-pdf-viewer-preference-show-outline.description: Demonstrates how to configure a PDF's viewer preference so the outline (bookmarks) panel is displayed by default, using dynamic access to stay compatible with older Aspose.Pdf versions.

set-multiple-viewer-preferences-pdf.title: Combine Viewer Preferences (Center Window and Hide Toolbar) in PDF
set-multiple-viewer-preferences-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, sets the ViewerPreferences to center the window and hide the toolbar (using dynamic access for version compatibility), and saves the updated document.

retrieve-pdf-viewer-preferences.title: Retrieve PDF Viewer Preferences and Display Them
retrieve-pdf-viewer-preferences.description: Loads a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf, accesses its ViewerPreferences, and prints each viewer setting to the console.

set-hide-menubar-viewer-preference.title: Set HideMenubar Viewer Preference in PDF
set-hide-menubar-viewer-preference.description: Demonstrates how to read the ViewerPreferences of a PDF, set the HideMenubar flag to true, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

change-pdf-viewer-preferences-save.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences and Save to New File
change-pdf-viewer-preferences-save.description: Loads a PDF, optionally sets viewer preferences such as hiding the toolbar and menubar if supported, and saves the modified document to a new file.

export-modified-pdf-to-memory-stream.title: Export Modified PDF to MemoryStream
export-modified-pdf-to-memory-stream.description: Demonstrates adding a text annotation to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and saving the modified document to a MemoryStream for downstream processing.

hide-pdf-toolbar-viewer-preference.title: Hide PDF Toolbar Using ViewerPreferences
hide-pdf-toolbar-viewer-preference.description: Demonstrates how to hide the PDF viewer toolbar by setting the HideToolbar viewer preference, using dynamic access to stay compatible with different Aspose.Pdf library versions.

hide-scrollbars-pdf-viewer.title: Enable HideScrollbars Viewer Preference in PDF
hide-scrollbars-pdf-viewer.description: Shows how to set the HideScrollbars viewer preference on a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with dynamic handling for library versions that may not expose the property.

enable-displaydoctitle-viewer-preference.title: Enable DisplayDocTitle Viewer Preference in PDF
enable-displaydoctitle-viewer-preference.description: Shows how to set the DisplayDocTitle viewer preference so the PDF's title appears in the window caption, using Aspose.Pdf with dynamic access for version compatibility.

retrieve-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-xml.title: Extract PDF Viewer Preferences and Save as XML
retrieve-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to retrieve a PDF's ViewerPreferences using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, serialize the object to XML, and write it to a configuration file.

apply-viewer-preferences-from-json.title: Apply Viewer Preferences to PDFs from JSON Configuration
apply-viewer-preferences-from-json.description: Loads viewer preference settings from a JSON file and applies them to each PDF in a folder, using dynamic access and reflection to support multiple Aspose.Pdf versions.

hide-toolbar-and-menubar-viewer-preferen.title: Set Viewer Preferences to Hide Toolbar and Menubar
hide-toolbar-and-menubar-viewer-preferen.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set the ViewerPreferences HideToolbar and HideMenubar flags for a minimalistic UI, and save the modified document, using dynamic access for version compatibility.

retrieve-verify-incremental-viewer-prefe.title: Add Text Stamp to All PDF Pages and Retrieve Viewer Preferences
retrieve-verify-incremental-viewer-prefe.description: Loads a PDF, adds a semi‑transparent "CONFIDENTIAL" text stamp to every page, optionally reads the document's ViewerPreferences, and saves the modified file.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-single-page.title: Set PDF Viewer Preference to Single Page Layout
set-pdf-viewer-preference-single-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set the ViewerPreferences.PageLayout to SinglePage (using dynamic for version‑compatibility), and save the updated document.

set-continuous-view-mode.title: Set Continuous View Mode for PDF
set-continuous-view-mode.description: Shows how to enable continuous scrolling (OneColumn layout) in a PDF by configuring viewer preferences with Aspose.Pdf, using reflection to stay compatible with different library versions.

map-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-toggles.title: Map PDF Viewer Preferences to UI Toggles and Update Them
map-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-toggles.description: Demonstrates reading Aspose.Pdf viewer preferences, mapping them to UI toggle controls, modifying the toggles at runtime, and writing the changes back to the PDF.

toggle-fullscreen-viewer-preference.title: Toggle FullScreen Viewer Preference in PDF
toggle-fullscreen-viewer-preference.description: Demonstrates how to enable or disable the FullScreen viewer preference of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with reflection to handle version differences.

apply-viewer-preferences-to-decrypted-pd.title: Apply Viewer Preferences to Encrypted PDF
apply-viewer-preferences-to-decrypted-pd.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with a password, set various viewer preferences using dynamic binding, and save the updated document.

export-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-xml.title: Export PDF Viewer Preferences to XML
export-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-xml.description: Loads a PDF document, retrieves its ViewerPreferences (if supported), and serializes the preferences to an XML file for legacy system integration.

hide-pdf-navigation-panels-use-none.title: Set PDF Viewer PageMode to UseNone
hide-pdf-navigation-panels-use-none.description: Shows how to hide all navigation panels by setting the viewer preference PageMode to UseNone, with dynamic fallback for older Aspose.Pdf versions.

add-web-link-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add External Link Annotation to PDF
add-web-link-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a clickable link annotation that opens an external website when clicked in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-to-specific-page.title: Add Image Stamp to Second Page of PDF
add-image-stamp-to-specific-page.description: Demonstrates how to create an image stamp from a PNG file and place it on the second page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-free-text-annotation-helvetica.title: Add Free‑Text Annotation with Helvetica Font to PDF
add-free-text-annotation-helvetica.description: Demonstrates how to add a free‑text annotation to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, specifying Helvetica font, 12 pt size, and blue color.

underline-specific-phrase-page-4.title: Underline Specific Phrase on PDF Page
underline-specific-phrase-page-4.description: Shows how to locate a given phrase on page 4 of a PDF and add an underline annotation beneath it using Aspose.Pdf.

add-square-annotation-red-border.title: Add Red Square Annotation with Transparent Fill to PDF Page 5
add-square-annotation-red-border.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a square annotation with a red border and 50% transparent red fill, and place it on the fifth page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-batch-text-annotations-to-pdf.title: Batch Add Text Annotations to PDF
add-batch-text-annotations-to-pdf.description: Shows how to add multiple text annotations to a PDF in a single batch by iterating over a list of annotation definitions using Aspose.Pdf.

add-semi-transparent-text-stamp.title: Set Annotation Opacity in PDF
add-semi-transparent-text-stamp.description: Shows how to change the opacity of a markup annotation in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

set-annotation-opacity-image-stamp.title: Add Text Annotation with Opacity to PDF
set-annotation-opacity-image-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to add a TextAnnotation to a PDF page using Aspose.PDF, set its opacity to 75%, and save the modified document.

rotate-text-annotation-90-degrees.title: Rotate Text Annotation by 90 Degrees in PDF
rotate-text-annotation-90-degrees.description: Shows how to add a text annotation to a PDF page and rotate it 90 degrees to match diagonal content using Aspose.Pdf.

add-text-annotation-thick-border.title: Add Text Annotation with Thick Border to PDF
add-text-annotation-thick-border.description: Shows how to place a text annotation on a PDF page and configure a solid 3‑point border using Aspose.Pdf.

create-dashed-rectangle-annotation.title: Add Dashed Border Rectangle Annotation to PDF
create-dashed-rectangle-annotation.description: Shows how to create a rectangle (square) annotation with a dashed border on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

set-light-gray-background-for-text-annot.title: Add Light Gray Background to Text Annotation
set-light-gray-background-for-text-annot.description: Demonstrates creating a TextAnnotation on a PDF page and setting its background color to light gray for improved readability on dark pages.

rotate-stamp-annotation-90-degrees.title: Rotate Image Stamp 90° Clockwise on PDF Page
rotate-stamp-annotation-90-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an image stamp, rotate it 90 degrees clockwise, center it on a page, and save the modified document.

add-file-attachment-annotation.title: Add File Attachment Annotation with Embedded File
add-file-attachment-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF and create a file‑attachment annotation that opens the attached file when the user clicks the annotation area.

add-javascript-alert-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Alert Link Annotation to PDF
add-javascript-alert-annotation-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a link annotation that executes JavaScript to display an alert when clicked, using Aspose.Pdf.

add-tooltip-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Tooltip Annotation to PDF
add-tooltip-annotation-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a text annotation that appears as a tooltip when the mouse hovers over a specific area in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-popup-annotation-with-bullet-list.title: Add Popup Annotation with Bullet Points to PDF
add-popup-annotation-with-bullet-list.description: Demonstrates how to create a TextAnnotation popup containing multi‑line bullet‑point text and add it to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-45-degree-rotation-to-stamp.title: Rotate Stamp Annotation on PDF Pages
apply-45-degree-rotation-to-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to add an image stamp to each page of a PDF and rotate it 45 degrees for diagonal placement using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-rtl-text-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add RTL Text Annotation to PDF
add-rtl-text-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a text annotation containing right‑to‑left Unicode (Arabic) text to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-red-highlight-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Red Square Annotation to PDF
add-red-highlight-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, creating a square annotation, setting its border color to bright red, and saving the modified document.

add-text-annotation-with-custom-author.title: Add Text Annotation with Author Metadata to PDF
add-text-annotation-with-custom-author.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a text annotation that includes custom author metadata, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-text-annotation-with-utc-timestamp.title: Add Text Annotation with UTC Timestamp to PDF
add-text-annotation-with-utc-timestamp.description: Demonstrates how to add a text annotation to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and set its Modified property to the current UTC time, providing an accurate creation timestamp in the document history.

add-subject-to-text-annotation.title: Add Subject‑Tagged Text Annotation to PDF
add-subject-to-text-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to create a text annotation on a PDF page and assign a Subject property for easier searching and categorization, then save the modified document.

lock-text-annotation.title: Lock a Text Annotation in a PDF
lock-text-annotation.description: Shows how to create a text annotation, set its Locked flag to prevent user edits, and save the PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

hide-annotations-when-fullscreen.title: Enable FullScreen Viewer Preference and Hide PDF Annotations
hide-annotations-when-fullscreen.description: Shows how to set the FullScreen viewer preference (using reflection for version compatibility) and hide all annotations in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-preserve-font-style.title: Replace Text on Specific PDF Page Preserving Font
replace-text-preserve-font-style.description: Shows how to replace a given string on page 2 of a PDF while preserving the original font style using Aspose.Pdf's PdfContentEditor.

replace-text-on-specific-pdf-page.description: Shows how to replace a given text string only on page 3 of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf Facades.

replace-phrase-bold-preserve-font-size.title: Replace Phrase and Apply Bold Formatting in PDF
replace-phrase-bold-preserve-font-size.description: Demonstrates how to locate a specific text phrase in a PDF, replace it with new text, and apply bold styling while preserving the original font size using Aspose.Pdf Facades.

insert-blank-page-add-header.title: Insert Blank Page and Header Annotation
insert-blank-page-add-header.description: Shows how to create a temporary blank PDF, insert its page into an existing document at position three, and add a text annotation as a header on the newly inserted page using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-page-from-pdf.title: Delete a Specific Page from a PDF
delete-page-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove page 5 from an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified document.

move-last-page-to-beginning.title: Move Last Page to Beginning of PDF
move-last-page-to-beginning.description: Shows how to reorder a PDF by inserting the last page at the start and removing its original occurrence using Aspose.Pdf.

add-annotation-and-merge-pdfs.title: Add Annotation and Merge PDFs
add-annotation-and-merge-pdfs.description: Shows how to add a text annotation to the first PDF page and then concatenate that annotated PDF with a second PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

split-pdf-into-single-page-files.title: Split Edited PDF into Single-Page Files with Annotations
split-pdf-into-single-page-files.description: Shows how to split a PDF that contains annotations into separate one‑page PDF files while preserving those annotations using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

insert-image-annotation-with-caption.title: Insert Image Annotation with Caption
insert-image-annotation-with-caption.description: Demonstrates how to add an image as a stamp annotation at specific coordinates and place a text caption annotation underneath using Aspose.Pdf Facades.

attach-image-add-stamp-annotation.title: Add Image Attachment and Stamp to PDF
attach-image-add-stamp-annotation.description: Shows how to embed an image file as an attachment in a PDF and then place the same image as a stamp annotation on the first page using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-annotations-from-json.title: Batch Add Text, Link, and Stamp Annotations to PDFs from JSON
batch-add-annotations-from-json.description: Shows how to read a JSON definition file and programmatically add text, hyperlink, and image stamp annotations to specific pages of PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.

add-attachment-and-encrypt-pdf.title: Encrypt PDF with Attachment and Viewer Preferences
add-attachment-and-encrypt-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, adds an embedded file attachment, sets viewer preferences, encrypts the document with user and owner passwords, and saves the encrypted PDF.

decrypt-edit-reencrypt-pdf.title: Decrypt, Edit, and Re‑Encrypt a Password‑Protected PDF
decrypt-edit-reencrypt-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with a user password, adding a text fragment, and then re‑encrypting the document with specific permissions before saving.

add-file-attachment-to-encrypted-pdf.title: Add Attachment to Encrypted PDF
add-file-attachment-to-encrypted-pdf.description: Shows how to open a password‑protected PDF with Aspose.Pdf, embed a file attachment, and save the document while preserving its encryption.

add-attachment-to-multiple-pdfs.title: Add Attachment to Multiple PDFs
add-attachment-to-multiple-pdfs.description: Shows how to batch‑process PDF files and embed the same attachment into each document using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-viewer-preferences-to-multiple-pdf.title: Apply Viewer Preferences to Multiple PDFs
apply-viewer-preferences-to-multiple-pdf.description: Shows how to loop through a list of PDF files, set common viewer preferences (toolbar, menubar, window centering, document title) using Aspose.Pdf, and save the updated PDFs to a separate folder.

rotate-pdf-pages-in-parallel.title: Parallel Batch PDF Processing with Text Stamp
rotate-pdf-pages-in-parallel.description: Demonstrates how to process multiple PDF files concurrently using Parallel.ForEach, add a centered text stamp to each document, and save the edited files to an output folder.

batch-remove-attachments-add-disclaimer.title: Remove Attachments and Add Disclaimer Annotation to PDFs
batch-remove-attachments-add-disclaimer.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑process PDF files by deleting all embedded attachments and inserting a standardized disclaimer text annotation on the first page of each document.

config-driven-pdf-pipeline-attachments-v.title: Configuration‑Driven PDF Pipeline: Add Attachments, Set Viewer Preferences, and Insert Annotations
config-driven-pdf-pipeline-attachments-v.description: Demonstrates a configuration‑driven pipeline that copies a PDF, embeds files, applies viewer preferences (with version‑safe dynamic binding), and adds text annotations to specified pages.

add-attachment-and-set-viewer-preference.title: Add Attachment and Set Viewer Preferences to PDF
add-attachment-and-set-viewer-preference.description: Shows how to embed a file into a PDF and configure viewer preferences such as hiding the toolbar and menu bar using Aspose.Pdf.

async-add-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Attachment to PDF Asynchronously
async-add-attachment-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a file into an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf while executing the operation on a background thread to avoid blocking the UI.

add-large-stream-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Large File Attachment to PDF Using Stream
add-large-stream-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to attach a large binary file to a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf while streaming the file to keep memory usage low.

add-network-attachment-to-pdf-with-retry.title: Add Attachment to PDF with Retry Download
add-network-attachment-to-pdf-with-retry.description: Downloads a file from a network URL with retry logic and embeds it as an attachment in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

compare-pdf-file-sizes-after-annotation.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF and Compare File Sizes
compare-pdf-file-sizes-after-annotation.description: The example loads an existing PDF, optionally adds an image stamp to the first page using Aspose.Pdf, saves the edited document, and then compares the file sizes of the original and edited PDFs to verify that changes were applied.

export-pdf-annotations-to-json.title: Export PDF Annotations to JSON
export-pdf-annotations-to-json.description: Shows how to read all annotations from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and write the collected data to a JSON file for external analysis.

import-annotations-from-json.title: Import JSON Annotations and Apply to PDF
import-annotations-from-json.description: Demonstrates loading annotation definitions from a JSON file, creating text annotations with PdfContentEditor, and saving the annotated PDF.

verify-text-annotation-position.title: Verify Text Annotation Position on PDF Page
verify-text-annotation-position.description: Creates a PDF, adds a text annotation, then loads the document to assert that the annotation's rectangle matches the expected coordinates.

edit-pdf-with-logging-using-pdfcontented.title: Log PDF Editing Operations with Timestamp
edit-pdf-with-logging-using-pdfcontented.description: Demonstrates how to edit a PDF using Aspose.Pdf (add image stamp and text annotation) while logging each operation with a timestamp and file name.

add-document-attachment-with-error-handl.title: Add File Attachment to PDF with Error Handling
add-document-attachment-with-error-handl.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file attachment into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while validating input paths and handling runtime errors.

edit-pdf-text-with-pdfcontenteditor-disp.title: Add Text Stamp to PDF and Properly Dispose PdfContentEditor
edit-pdf-text-with-pdfcontenteditor-disp.description: Demonstrates stamping every page of a PDF with a semi‑transparent text watermark and shows how to dispose a PdfContentEditor instance in a finally block to avoid memory leaks.

replace-text-pdf-using-pdfcontenteditor.title: Add Text to PDF Using PdfContentEditor and Document API
replace-text-pdf-using-pdfcontenteditor.description: Demonstrates how to edit a PDF by binding it with PdfContentEditor inside a using block and adding a text fragment via the Document API, then saving the result.

add-pdf-attachment-with-custom-mime-type.title: Add PDF Attachment with Description to PDF
add-pdf-attachment-with-custom-mime-type.description: Shows how to embed an external PDF file as an attachment in an existing PDF, set a custom description, and save the updated document.

add-js-action-change-page-bg-on-mouse-ov.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF, adding a TextAnnotation, and (when supported) attaching a JavaScript action that changes the page background color on mouse entry, with a fallback for older Aspose.Pdf versions.

extract-images-from-pdf__v3.title: Extract Images from PDF
extract-images-from-pdf__v3.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF document and save them as separate files in an output folder.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v3.title: Add File Attachment Annotation to PDF
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v3.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file (Terms.pdf) as an attachment annotation with a description on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Rotated Image Stamp to PDF
add-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp with 45‑degree rotation, 0.8 opacity, and specific coordinates on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json__v2.title: Populate PDF Form Fields from Configuration File
fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json__v2.description: Shows how to read default values from a simple key=value configuration file and assign them to PDF form fields using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-to-pdf-page__v2.title: Add Image Stamp from URL to PDF Page
add-image-stamp-to-pdf-page__v2.description: Downloads an image from an external URL, creates an ImageStamp, and places it on the second page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v4.title: Add File Attachment to PDF
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v4.description: Shows how to embed a local file as an attachment in an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

attach-multiple-files-to-pdf__v2.title: Attach Multiple Files to a PDF Document
attach-multiple-files-to-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, iterate through a folder of files, embed each file as an attachment using FileSpecification, and save the updated PDF.

add-text-annotation-to-pdf-page__v2.title: Add Text Annotation to PDF Page
add-text-annotation-to-pdf-page__v2.description: Shows how to place a text annotation with custom content at coordinates (100,200) on the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-highlight-annotation-to-pdf-page__v2.title: Highlight Text on PDF Page
add-highlight-annotation-to-pdf-page__v2.description: Demonstrates locating a specific text fragment on page 3 of a PDF and adding a yellow highlight annotation to it using Aspose.Pdf.

add-green-circle-annotation-to-pdf-page_.title: Add Circle Annotation with Green Outline to PDF Page
add-green-circle-annotation-to-pdf-page_.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a circle annotation with a thick green border around a specified rectangle on page six, and save the updated document.

add-popup-annotation-to-pdf__v3.title: Add Hover Popup Annotation to PDF
add-popup-annotation-to-pdf__v3.description: Demonstrates how to create a TextAnnotation that triggers a PopupAnnotation, showing a note when the user hovers over the annotation in a PDF document.

add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Internal Hyperlink to PDF Page
add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to create a link annotation that navigates to a specific page within the same PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-in-pdf__v2.title: Replace "Draft" with "Final" in a PDF
replace-text-in-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, replace all occurrences of a specific word, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf's PdfContentEditor.

add-image-to-pdf-using-pdffilemend__v2.title: Split PDF into Individual Page Files
add-image-to-pdf-using-pdffilemend__v2.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF document into separate one‑page PDF files using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.SplitToPages method.

print-selected-pdf-pages.title: Print PDF with Custom Page Ranges Using PrintDocument
print-selected-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to print specific page ranges (1‑5 and 8‑10) from a PDF by configuring PrinterSettings and using PdfViewer.PrintDocumentWithSettings.

add-line-annotation-with-arrowheads.title: Add Line Annotation with Arrowheads to PDF
add-line-annotation-with-arrowheads.description: Demonstrates how to insert a line annotation with arrowheads at both ends into a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-dashed-line-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Line Annotation with Arrow to PDF
add-dashed-line-annotation-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a line annotation with an arrow and custom color, add it to a page, and save the updated document.

add-free-text-html-annotation.title: Add Rich Text Free‑Text Annotation to PDF
add-free-text-html-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to add a free‑text annotation containing HTML rich text to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-using-regular-expressions.title: Regex Text Replacement in PDF
replace-text-using-regular-expressions.description: Shows how to search for text matching a regular expression across all pages of a PDF and replace it while preserving the original formatting using Aspose.Pdf.

add-watermark-to-pdfs-in-folder.title: Add Standard Watermark to All PDFs in a Folder
add-watermark-to-pdfs-in-folder.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF files in a directory, create a configurable watermark artifact, apply it to every page, and save the watermarked documents to an output folder.

verify-pdf-attachment-after-save.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file as an attachment in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, save the document, and verify that the attachment exists after saving.
